question: Where can I get a list of wind projects currently in permitting in Spain, with location, capacity (MW), developer, permitting stage and date?

answer.summary: Regional authorities publish project lists and maps, but the sources tested do not establish a complete, current national list. Aragon, Asturias, Cantabria, Catalonia, Galicia and Navarre provide complementary data. BOE notices include onshore and offshore projects and dated milestones; a notice alone does not establish the current stage.
main_caveats: No single source tested covers all autonomous and state permitting, including offshore projects.
Cantabria’s active layer included 2 operating parks among 13 records; check Estado_Adm.
Catalonia had 42 municipal rows for 30 applications; avoid counting rows as projects.
Navarre covers AAP/AAC projects not yet in operation, rather than all early applications.
The GEM wind tracker requires a form and uses broad development statuses; project records were not tested.
answer.confidence_reason: Regional services and documents were tested, but full geographic coverage, data currency and offshore completeness remain unchecked.

how_to_use.example_result: CAÑONERAS, EÓLICA 2000 SL, 32.3 MW, Funcionamiento definitivo.
steps: Query and paginate the feature layer; filter Estado_Adm and Funcionamiento to distinguish operating projects.
Catalonia API has 42 rows in tramitació for 30 distinct sol_licitud; group records by application before counting.
Asturias list PDF pages 1–2 gives project/expediente and BOPA milestone dates; a separate PDF gives turbine UTM coordinates.
Aragon resource 312 has admitted cases; resource 313 has AAP/AAC and 314 operating plants.
Navarre ZIP contains ENERGI_Lin_PeolicoTra.shp in EPSG:25830; first row REPOTENCIACIÓN SAN GREGORIO, ENHOL, 16.5 MW.

Galicia layer 1 request: https://ideg.xunta.gal/servizos/rest/services/RecursosEnerxeticos/enerxia_eolica_v2/MapServer/1/query?where=1%3D1&outFields=*&outSR=4326&resultRecordCount=2&f=json returns two XINZO NORTE turbines.
reading_traps: The active layer includes 2 operating entries among 13 tested.
Galicia layer comprises individual turbines, substations and towers, not one feature per wind farm.
Catalonia repeats projects by municipality and may place capacity on only one row.
Asturias list contains decisions described as unfavourable; being listed does not prove present permitting.
Coordinate samples in Navarre, Galicia and Cantabria were within broad regional bounding boxes; this does not test legal site boundaries.
Aragon source 313 is AAP/AAC, not in-service resource 314; the files omit stage dates.

recipe: Open the BOJA notice and extract peticionario, installation name, municipalities, expedition codes and potencia total instalada.
Read the seven UTM ETRS89 zone 30 turbine positions from the coordinate table, retaining the published coordinate reference system.
Search later notices for CG-1139 and AAU/MA/19/23 before describing the current stage.

history.note: Initial research pass: no single national structured dataset for permitting wind farms; split between MITECO (>50 MW, SABIA/BOE) and CCAA (<=50 MW, some structured like Aragon).
Tested six regional sources, recovered Navarra and the Galician service, and found two operating records in an active Cantabria layer.
